title: VanakkamRTP
description: A lightweight Random Teleport plugin with Tamil messages, configurable cooldowns, and safe teleport logic for Paper/Spigot servers.
body:
## 🇹🇳 VanakkamRTP

VanakkamRTP is a lightweight Random Teleport (RTP) plugin made especially for Tamil Minecraft servers.

It allows players to safely teleport to random locations with a configurable cooldown and clean Tamil messages.

---

### ✨ Features
- 📍 Random Teleport command (`/rtp`)
- 🛡️ Safe location detection (no lava / void)
- ⏱️ Configurable cooldown
- 🎨 Color code support
- 🇮🇳 Tamil language messages
- ⚙️ Simple configuration
- 🚀 Lightweight & optimized

---

### 📦 Compatibility
- Server software: **Paper / Spigot**
- Minecraft versions: **1.21.x**

---

### 📁 Commands

/rtp - Teleport to a random safe location


---

### ⚙️ Configuration
All messages and cooldown values can be edited in `config.yml`.
